posts.cooked:
For those who are still looking for a storage box, I discovered that Go7 Gaming (http://go7gaming.com/) is creating a box insert designed for Sentinels of the Multiverse. After contacting them, they said "the insert is complete and everything is in place.  We will be launching next month."

Nothing more!

posts.name: UXM266
posts.cooked:
Sefirit:

What I want to know is how well it fits sleeved cards.

 

  1. From their kickstarter page: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1144387021/board-game-storage-chests-tokens-inserts-and-more

"Some designs are so space constrained that your sleeving choices will be restricted (hint: Ultra Pro Standard and Mayday Standard will always work with any of our inserts), "

 

  1. From their website: Sleeving Cards & Our Inserts – Go7Gaming

"Bottom Line: If you sleeve using Ultra Pro Deck Protectors/Standard/Pro Fit, Mayday Premium, or KMC you can stop reading now.  Your cards will store fine in any of our inserts and storage chests. "

 

 

Hope this helps!

 

NOTE: I do not work for, nor have I ever bought from the site. I only discoevred this through research. I have no clue on the qwuality, but reviews seem to eb positive.
